# Promptimizer

Quality-aware LLM routing for any OpenAI-compatible key.

Promptimizer sits in front of cheap and frontier models. It classifies each request (L1–L5), routes to the cheapest adequate tier, caches repeated system/context prefixes, and reports cost saved versus always-frontier together with a quality score.

## Product rules

- Bring your own key. Any OpenAI-compatible `/v1`.
- Step up, never down.
- Measure quality. Savings from silent degradation fail the demo.
- Simulator needs no vendor key: `promptimizer-nano`, `promptimizer-flash`, `promptimizer-frontier`.
